This '''species''' was a [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]] that existed in [[the galaxy]].<ref name="LF" />

==Biology and appearance==
This small [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]<ref name="LF" /> was distinguished by [[Dug]]-like bodies, seeming to balance on their [[Limb|arms]] while they user their legs and feet to perform tasks. They had a fleshy appearance, with skin that was [[Color|gray]], purple, and tan, with small brown spots spready across their bodies. Their faces were asymmetrical, with jagged [[Tooth|teeth]], large crooked [[nose]]s, pointed [[ear]]s, and bulging [[eye]]s that featured black sclera and bright blue pupils.<ref name="VG" />

==Species in the galaxy==
In [[132 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> a member of this species, the champion [[velospeeder]] rider [[Miow Joon]], was employed at the<ref name="VG" /> [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] on the [[planet]] [[Ueda]],<ref name="ShopDatabank">{{Databank|lomi-usqi-noodle-shop|Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop}}</ref> peddling the noodle-drying rack in exchange for space to work out and free [[Foodstuff|food]].<ref name="VG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The species made their debut in the [[Lost / Found|first episode]] of the [[2024]] television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte]]'', directed by [[Leslye Headland]],<ref name="LF" /> before being shown in better detail in previews for the ''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''.<ref name="Edelweiss">''[[Star Wars: The Acolyte: The Visual Guide]]''</ref>
